caption: The drawing depicts a single, light-colored ankle boot with a high shaft extending above the ankle. The boot is shown in a side profile, with its toe pointing to the right. It features a series of round, prominent buttons running up the front side, each affixed to a scalloped edge, forming a decorative closure that extends from the top of the boot’s shaft down to the instep. The body of the boot is rendered in shades of cream and light tan, with subtle shading and texture suggesting a soft, possibly leather material. The heel is low, square, and is depicted in a brown hue distinct from the rest of the boot. The background consists of an even, light beige color, devoid of any additional objects or decorative elements.
title: Woman's Shoe
